t: You're looking at Sir William Powell's Almshouses, a row of twelve homes at Church Gate in Fulham. They're Grade II* listed, which means they're protected as buildings of more than ordinary interest. The architect was John Pollard Seddon, who worked largely on churches, so it's fitting to see that ecclesiastical eye brought to a humble almshouse row. Seddon is the name to remember here, because his design is why this small group of homes is listed so highly.
